lede: Wat Pa Muang accounts for 6 catalogued manuscripts, 4 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (83%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (17%).
